crop.description: Downtown Bridgeport west bank of the inner harbour, south of the authored McCluster City frame
crop.selection: complete footprints whose exterior area centroid lies inside bbox

heightRule.roof: area-weighted 95th percentile of the mean z of non-vertical 3D roof faces (above the multipatch bottom slab) whose interior point lies in the footprint; baseFt is the bottom slab
heightRule.ground: median bare-earth DEM post inside the footprint (stage 2)

terrain.order: row-major from the north-west post; row r is northing originM[1] - (r + 0.5) * stepM, column c is easting originM[0] + (c + 0.5) * stepM
